A LITTLE MORE ABOUT THE PERSON BEHIND THE PAGE

Hi, I'm Taylor! ♡

I'm a wife, a mom to two boys, a Marine spouse, and a real estate agent who calls the Charleston Lowcountry home. Real estate is a big part of my world, but it definitely isn't my whole personality—and I wouldn't want it to be!

Most days, you'll find me with a coffee in hand, cheering on my boys at baseball or wrestling, keeping up with our two dogs, Winston and Rory, or finding a little time for my garden, a crochet project, or something cozy around the house. Family, home, and the little everyday moments mean everything to me.

Being part of a military family has taught me how much a place can mean when you're building a life somewhere new. I love helping people feel at home in the Lowcountry, whether they're moving here for the first time, finding their next house, or simply looking for a local recommendation.

I created The Lowcountry Home Edit to share more than listings: helpful guides, local favorites, real-life moments, and the things that make a house—and a community—feel like home. I'm so happy you're here.

With love, Taylor ♡
